clauses.actor_role: You (the individual, business, or organization on whose behalf the materials are used)
clauses.scope_note: Covers the defined Covered Materials: the supplied application code, scripts, Skills and documentation, including copies and modifications, but not separately licensed Section 8 materials. Permits download, installation, running, private copying, inspection and modification without a license fee. Business use qualifies only if both Revenue and Funding are below the threshold; genuinely personal use outside Business Use is an alternative. Eligible use includes internal production, use with AI agents and Blender, and a hosted service on infrastructure under Your control. Making Kit code available to customers, including through their browsers, is redistribution and is not authorized by this clause.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission applies if either use is genuinely personal and outside Business Use, or both business Revenue and Funding are below JPY 100,000,000. These are alternative eligibility paths; do not assume either predicate is satisfied.

clauses.scope_note: Allows necessary private copies to Your personnel and infrastructure or AI service providers acting solely to carry out Your permitted use. Does not allow publication of the Kit or granting customers copies or independent rights. You remain responsible for keeping the use within Your permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: Each listed condition applies: copies must be necessary for permitted use; recipients must act solely to carry it out; confidentiality and no independent reuse must be ensured.

clauses.clause_label: Section 3 — Business Use requiring a separate commercial agreement
clauses.scope_note: Applies to Business Use of the Covered Materials, including internal production and product or service integration, including use by an individual. Downloading an update, making an inquiry, or receiving an invoice alone does not authorize use.
clauses.condition_explanation: When Business Use occurs and either Revenue or Funding reaches JPY 100,000,000, You must obtain a separate written commercial agreement before that use. Revenue and Funding are tested separately.

clauses.clause_label: Section 3 — Eligibility reassessment and threshold reached during use
clauses.scope_note: Requires assessing eligibility before Business Use and sets reassessment timing. Revenue is reassessed at fiscal-year end, with the new assessment applying from the next fiscal year; where there is no defined or completed fiscal year, actual Revenue is monitored under Section 1 periods and reaching the threshold requires an agreement before further Business Use. Funding is cumulative and must be reassessed when additional qualifying funds are received; reaching its threshold requires an agreement before further Business Use. If a threshold is reached while using Section 2, obtain the agreement before continuing Business Use. Compliant earlier use is not retroactively charged. No automatic grace period, commercial trial, or evaluation-use exception is granted; any such permission must be in writing. Reading public source, GitHub activities under Section 4, and retaining an inactive archival copy do not themselves require a paid commercial agreement.
clauses.condition_explanation: The obligation applies when Business Use is subject to the Section 3 threshold or reassessment rules. For Revenue, the applicable assessment date depends on the fiscal-year rules; for Funding, reassessment follows receipt of additional qualifying funds. Reaching either threshold requires an agreement before further Business Use.

clauses.clause_label: Section 3 — Commercial agreement scope, fees, and expiry
clauses.scope_note: Fees, duration, authorized users, integration scope, and any redistribution rights are negotiated in the separate agreement; no fixed price, per-user charge, automatic renewal, or obligation to offer an agreement is established. Unless expressly agreed otherwise, the arrangement covers only specified usage rights and access to publicly released updates during its term, not support, setup assistance, commissioned production, custom development, guaranteed results, or future updates. On expiry, Business Use must stop unless You renewed, have other written permission, or then qualify under Section 2. Authorized Outputs remain subject to Section 6 and do not incur a continuing Kit fee.
clauses.condition_explanation: Permission under this clause depends on an agreement being in force and the use falling within its expressly agreed scope and term. After expiry, Business Use may continue only under one of the stated exceptions.

clauses.scope_note: Regardless of the financial threshold, permits viewing and forking the public repository within GitHub, retaining and modifying forks there, and submitting issues, patches, and pull requests. It does not permit otherwise restricted Business Use. The clause does not narrow rights granted by applicable GitHub Terms of Service for GitHub's operation of public repositories.
